description: Feature scenario catalog. Every row targets one implementation risk in database.rs and must have a falsifiable external oracle.

scenarios.title: Narrow rows fill multiple leaf pages
scenarios.risk: Leaf split and divider keys must preserve rowid order across pages

oracle.method: row-by-row order comparison plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: narrow rows fill multiple leaf pages with matching dividers

scenarios.title: Wide rows with overflow payloads
scenarios.risk: Overflow chain ownership, payload split and repeated 3000 byte blobs

scale.shape: every 10th row carries a 3000 byte BLOB

oracle.method: per-row sha256 of the blob plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: wide rows round trip every overflow payload

scenarios.title: Shuffled rowids with a middle delete
scenarios.risk: Interior page upper-bound keys and routing after deleting a contiguous middle range

scale.shape: shuffled rowids then delete 200 middle rows

oracle.method: row-by-row comparison of the surviving 800 rows in both directions plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: deleting the middle 200 rows keeps interior routing exact

scenarios.title: WITHOUT ROWID shuffled insert
scenarios.risk: Primary-key index b-tree walk when rows were inserted out of key order

scale.shape: WITHOUT ROWID table with shuffled keys

oracle.method: sorted primary-key comparison plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: WITHOUT ROWID rows stay in primary-key order

scenarios.title: Secondary index with many duplicate keys
scenarios.risk: Multi-page index key order with rowid tie breaks and automatic indexes

scale.shape: 10 distinct labels repeated 100 times, plus a UNIQUE autoindex

oracle.method: INDEXED BY ordered comparison of label and rowid pairs plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: duplicate index keys preserve label and rowid order

scenarios.title: Mixed serial types at scale
scenarios.risk: Serial type widths for i64 extremes, REAL, UTF-8 text, NULL and BLOB

scale.shape: i64 min and max, fractional REAL, Chinese text, NULL and BLOB

oracle.method: typed value comparison in both directions plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: mixed serial types survive both directions

scenarios.title: WAL with 50 transactions and repeated checkpoints
scenarios.risk: WAL replay across repeated checkpoint rotations and truncation

scale.shape: 50 transactions of 20 rows with a PASSIVE checkpoint after each round

oracle.method: row-by-row comparison, -wal and -shm existence, PRAGMA integrity_check

scenarios.title: Crash during a 1000 row write
scenarios.risk: Hot journal rollback of partially written pages

scale.shape: 1000 committed rows then a 200 row transaction killed before commit

oracle.method: committed row comparison after crash plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: hot journal rolls a killed 200 row transaction back

scenarios.title: Thousand updates of one key
scenarios.risk: In-page rewrite and change counter after repeated UPDATE on one rowid

scale.shape: 1000 successive updates of one row in both directions

oracle.method: final value comparison in both directions plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: thousand same-key updates settle on one value

scenarios.title: Same workload at 512, 1024 and 4096
scenarios.risk: Hard-coded page size assumptions in header parsing and B-tree math

scale.shape: identical rows at each legal page size

oracle.method: PRAGMA page_size and header offset 16 comparison plus row-by-row read

cases.sqlite.ts: page sizes 512 1024 and 4096 agree with external pragma

scenarios.title: UTF-16 database at scale
scenarios.risk: Text decoding when the schema and rows declare UTF-16

oracle.method: PRAGMA encoding plus row-by-row text comparison

cases.sqlite.ts: 1000 UTF-16 rows decode through the declared encoding

scenarios.title: STRICT, view and virtual tables
scenarios.risk: Unsupported schema objects must fail closed instead of being misread

scale.shape: STRICT table plus a view and an FTS5 virtual table

oracle.method: sqlite_master comparison and expected rejection errors

cases.sqlite.ts: STRICT tables read while views and virtual tables fail closed

scenarios.title: REAL affinity on integral and fractional values
scenarios.risk: Integral REAL values are stored as integers and may report the wrong storage class

scale.shape: half integral and half fractional values in a REAL column

oracle.method: numeric value comparison against external typeof output plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: REAL affinity keeps numeric values at 1000 rows

scenarios.title: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY rowid alias at scale
scenarios.risk: Explicit ids and rowid alias drift, including extreme ids

scale.shape: shuffled explicit ids including negative and large values

oracle.method: rowid equals id comparison in both directions plus PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.sqlite.ts: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY stays a rowid alias at 1000 rows

scenarios.title: Schema listing at scale
scenarios.risk: sqlite_master decoding with explicit indexes and an automatic index

scale.shape: table with two explicit indexes and one UNIQUE autoindex

oracle.method: sqlite_master type and name comparison plus rootpage sanity

cases.sqlite.ts: sqlite_master lists explicit and automatic indexes at scale
